integrity: The proof is reconstructed from standard linearization of bi-Lipschitz maps, finite-dimensional norm equivalence, Mason's 2026 Dunford--Pettis theorem and permanence lemmas, and the Godefroy--Kalton lifting theorem. No independent audit or external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The obstruction is to complemented embeddings and isomorphisms into countable ell_1-sums whose metric pieces admit finite-dimensional bi-Lipschitz models. It does not rule out non-complemented embeddings, does not cover source spaces that have the Dunford--Pettis property, and does not assert the Dunford--Pettis property for arbitrary doubling metrics.
title: A Dunford--Pettis obstruction to finite-dimensional \(\ell_1\)-models of Lipschitz-free spaces
